name: cloudy-ai-tokens-api
description: Fleet token engine: lists, generates, reveals and revokes every fleet bearer token (fleet ft_ tokens and adopted Authelia JWTs); introspect-proxy asks it before accepting a Bearer, so a revoked token stops working within 60 seconds. Public address: c3-pvt.diegonmarcos.com/tokens-api (shared gate, #1104); mesh tokens-api.mesh.diegonmarcos.com

unit.cmd: python3 -m pip install -q flask==3.0.0 'PyJWT[crypto]==2.9.0' cryptography==43.0.3 pytest && python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test

api.description: Owner-only token manager (list, reveal, generate, import, revoke, audit) and the mesh-only /v1/verify that introspect-proxy calls.

legacy_aliases._doc: API rebrand #1450: the old names stay served for one release (DNS alias, Caddy path rewrite from _rebrand-1450/caddy-legacy-redirects.caddy, old image tag). Remove after the alias release.

_gateway: Reached publicly only through cloudy-ai-api at /ai/<name> (old /<name>-api path is a gateway legacy route).
